name: Meteora

requiredConfig.name: Dialect client key
requiredConfig.description: Needed for generic position and market reads until a first-class Meteora adapter exists.

requiredConfig.name: Meteora DLMM position endpoint
requiredConfig.description: Planned endpoint for wallet-specific DLMM position status. Not implemented in MCP runtime yet.

readCapabilities.returns: Planned DLMM position facts: pool, bins/range, token balances, fees, rewards, and position health.
Planned generic wallet positions when Dialect connector reads are configured.
Planned market and action URL facts for Meteora pools.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A planned approval-bound Blink action for add liquidity, withdraw liquidity, claim fees, or close position. MCP runtime does not expose the generic Blink helper yet.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Meteora Solana Action transaction after the user reviews pool, position, token amounts, and fee facts.

requiredUserInputs.name: poolAddress
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Meteora pool or DLMM position should I use?

requiredUserInputs.name: amount
requiredUserInputs.prompt: How much liquidity or token amount should I prepare?

requiredUserInputs.name: blinkUrl
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Paste the Meteora Blink or Solana Action URL for this action.

requiredConnectorFacts: Current bin range or liquidity range
Blink action URL and action metadata
Wallet token balances for both pool tokens
unsupportedRequests: Prepare Meteora actions without a pool, position, or Blink URL.
Claim fees when no position address is supplied.
Close a position without first reading position facts.
Move funds without a wallet signature.
actionPreparationNotes: Until a first-class adapter lands, treat Meteora actions as Blink-backed. The agent may review supplied action metadata, but must not invent pool, range, or fee facts. Ask for pool/position and Blink URL when missing.
riskNotes: Meteora DLMM positions are sensitive to range selection, bin movement, fees, rewards, and impermanent loss. Display pool and position facts before approval.
walletApprovalBoundary: The connector may read pool and position facts when configured. Writes are Blink-backed and only prepare a wallet approval request; the wallet signs separately.

needsInputQuestions: Which position address or pool should I check?
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. Provide the position or pool so it can read connector facts.

needsInputQuestions: Which Meteora position should I read?
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. Fee reads require a wallet position.

requests.user: add liquidity to this Meteora pool
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. Pool, amounts, and action URL are required.

requests.user: add 1 SOL and 100 USDC to Meteora with this Blink URL
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Meteora Blink review if the action metadata matches the requested pool and amounts. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: claim fees from my Meteora position using this action URL
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a claim-fees Blink review after checking the position id and action metadata.

requests.user: close my Meteora position without checking it
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because position facts are required before a close action can be reviewed.

requests.user: guarantee this Meteora range is safe
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because it cannot guarantee safety or profitability.
The agent denied this because Meteora connector actions are only cataloged for mainnet-beta.

requests.user: move my Meteora LP without opening my wallet
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because the connector cannot move funds without the user's wallet.

requests.user: what is the APY on this Meteora pool?
needsInputQuestions: Which pool address should I read?
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. A pool address is required before reading market facts.
